h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Kharagpur

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Kharagpur

items.pText: Kharagpur is a railway town with one of the longest railway platforms in India, a large railway workshop and an IIT campus, with an air force station nearby. Its campuses and railway colonies have wide roads, cycle tracks and a lot of traffic moving between them. FunPlay Systems supplies playground equipment for these sites from our factory in Vasai, about 1,530 km away, and sends it to West Bengal by road.

On a campus or colony with constant cycle and scooter traffic, the boundary of the play area matters as much as the equipment inside it. Children leave a swing or slide at speed and rarely look before running. We plan the layout so that exits face away from roads and paths, with a hedge, fence or open lawn between the play area and moving traffic. The climate here is hot and humid, with a heavy monsoon, so drainage gets attention too.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Keeping a play area clear of roads and cycle tracks

c: Set the play area back from the road, and put the gate on the side that faces a lawn or a quiet footpath. Point slide exits and swing arcs inward, towards the centre of the play area. A low hedge or fence along the road side stops a ball, or a child chasing one, from rolling into traffic. Keep cycle stands outside the boundary so bikes are never parked inside a safe play area.

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 1,530 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: How should a playground be placed near a road?
items.a: Set back from the road, with the gate facing a quiet side and slide exits pointing inward. A hedge or fence along the road side keeps balls and children from running into traffic.

items.q: Can campuses and railway colonies in Kharagpur order from you?
items.a: Yes. Campuses, colonies, schools and housing complexes can order directly. We deliver from Vasai by road and install with our own team or a dealer in eastern India.

items.q: Does Kharagpur's monsoon affect the play area?
items.a: Heavy rain can pool on flat ground, so plan a slight slope and a drain before installation. Galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts handle the wet season without rusting.
